column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah E99011: Liushih menemukan "ular baja" logistik Mangi Security,
# regu Doll generasi ketiga menghancurkannya, lalu drone pengejar dijatuhkan lewat
# gangguan elektromagnetik di kanyon.
# Tetap Inggris: Liushih, Dilu, Zhisui, OTs-14, Sextans, Mangi Security, Mokosh,
# Commander, Doll, Neural cloud, OA system, bunker buster.
(Yellow sand filled the sky, visibility was less than fifty meters.)
column2: (Pasir kuning memenuhi langit, jarak pandang kurang dari lima puluh meter.)

column1: (For most combat units, this is extremely harsh weather. But for Liushih, who is penetrating deep alone, this is simply excellent cover.)
column2: (Bagi sebagian besar unit tempur, ini cuaca yang sangat ganas. Tapi bagi Liushih yang menyusup sendirian, ini justru penyamaran yang sempurna.)

column1: (Liushih lay on Dilu's back. The mechanical horse's power mode had been switched to silent mode, and its mechanical legs operated alternately, leaving almost no trace on the soft sand dunes.)
column2: (Liushih menelungkup di punggung Dilu. Mode tenaga kuda mekanis itu sudah dialihkan ke mode senyap, dan kaki-kaki mekanisnya bergerak bergantian, nyaris tanpa meninggalkan jejak di gundukan pasir yang lembut.)

column1: (Just as she is about to climb over a massive, abandoned desertified rock hill ahead—)
column2: (Tepat saat dia hendak mendaki bukit batu raksasa yang telah menggurun dan terbengkalai di depannya—)

column1: Dilu, take cover!
column2: Dilu, berlindung!

column1: (Swish—)
column2: (Wusshh—)

column1: (Dilu reacts instantly, taking Liushih and swiftly pressing into the shadows on the leeward side of the rock hill.)
column2: (Dilu bereaksi seketika, membawa Liushih dan cepat merapat ke bayangan di sisi bukit batu yang terlindung angin.)

column1: (Less than ten meters above their heads, two Mangi Security patrol drones flash with red lights, emitting a low hum as they slowly sweep over the location where they were just standing.)
column2: (Kurang dari sepuluh meter di atas kepala mereka, dua drone patroli Mangi Security berkelip merah, mengeluarkan dengung rendah sambil menyapu perlahan tempat mereka berdiri tadi.)

column1: (Liushih held her breath, her finger even already on the trigger of her self-defense weapon. Once discovered, in this open area, she wouldn't even have the chance to call for reinforcements.)
column2: (Liushih menahan napas, jarinya bahkan sudah menempel di pelatuk senjata pertahanan dirinya. Begitu ditemukan, di area terbuka seperti ini, dia bahkan tidak akan punya kesempatan memanggil bantuan.)

column1: (One second, two seconds... ten seconds.)
column2: (Satu detik, dua detik... sepuluh detik.)

column1: (The drone's red light didn't stop, disappearing into the distant sandstorm along its set route.)
column2: (Lampu merah drone itu tidak berhenti, lalu hilang ke badai pasir di kejauhan mengikuti rute yang sudah ditetapkan.)

column1: Phew... that was close. Thanks, Dilu.
column2: Fyuh... hampir saja. Makasih, Dilu.

column1: (Liushih patted the mechanical horse's cold neck armor, then flipped and leaped onto the highest point of the rocky hill.)
column2: (Liushih menepuk pelindung leher kuda mekanis yang dingin itu, lalu berjungkir dan melompat ke titik tertinggi bukit batu.)

column1: (She set up high-magnification binoculars, penetrated the obstacle of the sandstorm, and looked towards the canyon basin behind the rocky hill.)
column2: (Dia memasang binokular perbesaran tinggi, menembus halangan badai pasir, dan menatap ke cekungan kanyon di belakang bukit batu itu.)

column1: (The next second, her pupils suddenly contracted.)
column2: (Sedetik kemudian, pupilnya mengecil mendadak.)

column1: Then...?
column2: Lalu...?

column1: (What appeared in Liushih's field of vision were two groups of Mangi Security members wearing the same uniform, but they seemed to be arguing. Liushih was too far away to hear clearly.)
column2: (Yang muncul di bidang pandang Liushih adalah dua kelompok anggota Mangi Security berseragam sama, tapi sepertinya mereka sedang berdebat. Liushih terlalu jauh untuk mendengar jelas.)

column1: (In order to get close to the opponent, she shuttled between the wreckage of several armored vehicles, and using cover, she forcefully sneaked to a position less than a hundred meters away from the enemy convoy.)
column2: (Untuk mendekat, dia berpindah-pindah di antara bangkai beberapa kendaraan lapis baja, dan dengan memakai penutup, dia memaksa dirinya menyelinap ke posisi kurang dari seratus meter dari konvoi musuh.)

column1: (There was an armored command vehicle here that was obviously responsible for regional communication relay. They were arguing very fiercely, but Liushih herself couldn't hear clearly.)
column2: (Di situ ada kendaraan komando lapis baja yang jelas bertugas sebagai relai komunikasi wilayah. Mereka berdebat sangat sengit, tapi Liushih sendiri tetap tidak bisa mendengar jelas.)

column1: (In order to hear their words clearly, Liushih gently patted Dilu and arranged tactics via neural link with Dilu.)
column2: (Supaya bisa mendengar jelas, Liushih menepuk lembut Dilu dan menyusun taktik lewat tautan neural bersama Dilu.)

column1: (Soon, amidst the sky full of blowing sand, an unnoticed mechanical horse gently approached. Dilu snuck closer in a way that made almost no sound.)
column2: (Tak lama, di tengah langit penuh pasir bertiup, seekor kuda mekanis mendekat pelan tanpa disadari siapa pun. Dilu menyelinap makin dekat dengan cara yang nyaris tanpa suara.)

column1: How many times do I have to tell you? The approval authority for material distribution is not in my hands. I can only load the truck when I see the list.
column2: Berapa kali harus kubilang? Wewenang persetujuan distribusi materiil bukan di tanganku. Aku baru bisa memuat truk kalau daftarnya sudah kulihat.

column1: (Soon, Dilu transmitted the video data from ahead. Liushih watched carefully.)
column2: (Tak lama, Dilu mengirimkan data video dari depan. Liushih menyimaknya dengan teliti.)

column1: What do you mean "although you don't have a list, the materials must be loaded onto your truck and taken away"?
column2: Apa maksudmu "meski kalian tidak punya daftar, materiilnya harus dimuat ke truk kalian dan dibawa pergi"?

column1: Your bullshit approval authority is clearly just making trouble out of nothing!
column2: Wewenang persetujuan sampahmu itu jelas cuma bikin masalah dari yang tidak ada!

column1: Our frontline command post has already called your logistics support department, why can't we load the truck and take it away?
column2: Pos komando garis depan kami sudah menelepon departemen dukungan logistik kalian, kenapa kami tidak boleh memuat dan membawanya?

column1: I told you, this isn't the logistics support department, I'm with the logistics transport regiment.
column2: Sudah kubilang, ini bukan departemen dukungan logistik, aku dari regimen transpor logistik.

column1: The logistics support department's process needs to go through the logistics command's procedures, it hasn't even circulated to us. I just showed you my OA system, I'm not lying to you!
column2: Proses departemen dukungan logistik harus melewati prosedur komando logistik, dan itu bahkan belum sampai ke kami. Aku baru saja menunjukkan OA system-ku, aku tidak membohongimu!

column1: The damn logistics command was just disbanded by the logistics headquarters yesterday! How are they supposed to approve your process?!
column2: Komando logistik sialan itu baru kemarin dibubarkan markas besar logistik! Bagaimana mereka bisa menyetujui prosesmu?!

column1: Then go find the Logistics Command, why are you yelling at me?
column2: Ya sudah, cari saja Logistics Command, kenapa membentak aku?

column1: Besides, do you think you're the only ones getting stuck in the process?
column2: Lagi pula, kau pikir cuma kalian yang tersangkut prosedur?

column1: The forklifts promised by the logistics headquarters last month haven't even shown a shadow until now. All the supplies that could be transported were hauled up by the boys of the transport regiment grunting and groaning!
column2: Forklift yang dijanjikan markas besar logistik bulan lalu sampai sekarang bayangannya pun tidak kelihatan. Semua pasokan yang masih bisa diangkut dipikul anak-anak regimen transpor sambil mengerang!

column1: The support department doesn't care at all whether we can transport it or not, they just send the stuff and consider it done. Supplies are piled up like mountains, placed in the open as targets for people to shoot at. It's a good thing our boss found this canyon, otherwise there would be nowhere to hide.
column2: Departemen dukungan sama sekali tidak peduli kami bisa mengangkutnya atau tidak, mereka kirim barangnya lalu anggap beres. Pasokan menumpuk seperti gunung, ditaruh di tempat terbuka jadi sasaran tembak orang. Untung bos kami menemukan kanyon ini, kalau tidak tidak ada tempat sembunyi.

column1: I really want to help you too, but our loading boys aren't robots. No matter how urgent you are, you have to line up.
column2: Aku juga sungguh ingin membantumu, tapi anak-anak bongkar-muat kami bukan robot. Sedesak apa pun kalian, tetap harus mengantre.

column1: So I told you from the beginning, we'll load the stuff and take it away ourselves, we don't need your people. Why can't you understand?!
column2: Makanya dari awal sudah kubilang, kami muat dan angkut sendiri barangnya, kami tidak butuh orang kalian. Kenapa tidak bisa paham?!

column1: Then do you have the form?
column2: Kalau begitu, formulirnya ada?

column1: I really fucking have to control you!
column2: Sialan, kenapa aku harus meladeni orang sepertimu!

column1: (Liushih listened to the wiretap recording transmitted by Dilu. Just analyzing the department names mentioned in the conversation made Liushih's Neural cloud system feel chaotic.)
column2: (Liushih menyimak rekaman sadapan yang dikirim Dilu. Menganalisis nama-nama departemen yang disebut dalam percakapan itu saja sudah membuat sistem Neural cloud Liushih terasa kacau.)

column1: ...I see.
column2: ...Begitu ya.

column1: Although I didn't understand what they were saying either, what can be confirmed is that the enemy's logistics are very chaotic.
column2: Meski aku juga tidak paham apa yang mereka bicarakan, yang bisa dipastikan adalah logistik musuh sangat kacau.

column1: From what they mean, perhaps the distribution center is nearby.
column2: Dari maksud pembicaraan mereka, mungkin pusat distribusinya ada di dekat sini.

column1: (Thinking of this, Liushih controlled Dilu to return to her side.)
column2: (Berpikir sampai situ, Liushih memerintahkan Dilu kembali ke sisinya.)

column1: (Then she and Dilu bypassed the two groups of arguing Mangi Security members and came to the position behind them.)
column2: (Lalu dia dan Dilu melewati dua kelompok anggota Mangi Security yang berdebat itu dan sampai ke posisi di belakang mereka.)

column1: (After scaling several hills, what appeared in Liushih's line of sight wasn't the dispersed, hidden battlefield logistics nodes she had expected, but rather an exceedingly exaggerated, bloated steel serpent.)
column2: (Setelah mendaki beberapa bukit, yang muncul di garis pandang Liushih bukan simpul logistik medan tempur yang tersebar dan tersembunyi seperti dia perkirakan, melainkan seekor ular baja yang gembung dan berlebihan.)

column1: (Hundreds of heavy transport vehicles, fuel tankers, and ammo supply trucks were connected bumper-to-bumper along the narrow main road of the basin...)
column2: (Ratusan kendaraan transpor berat, tanker bahan bakar, dan truk pasokan amunisi berderet rapat bemper-ke-bemper sepanjang jalan utama cekungan yang sempit itu...)

column1: (Mangi Security's massive transport convoy stretched continuously... you couldn't even see the end of it at a glance!)
column2: (Konvoi transpor raksasa Mangi Security membentang tanpa putus... ujungnya bahkan tidak terlihat sekali pandang!)

column1: (Still reeling from the shock, Liushih connected the transmission to OTs-14.)
column2: (Masih belum pulih dari keterpanaan, Liushih menyambungkan transmisi ke OTs-14.)

column1: Miss OTs-14! Intel confirmed!
column2: Miss OTs-14! Intel terkonfirmasi!

column1: I take back what I said before, we indeed didn't find any high-value tactical targets.
column2: Aku tarik kembali ucapanku tadi, kita memang tidak menemukan target taktis bernilai tinggi.

column1: So, the reconnaissance result is nothing gained?
column2: Jadi, hasil pengintaiannya nihil?

column1: It's okay, as long as you retreat safely.
column2: Tidak masalah, selama kau bisa mundur dengan aman.

column1: No, I mean—
column2: Bukan, maksudku—

column1: I found a super high, no, extremely high-value tactical target.
column2: Aku menemukan target taktis bernilai super tinggi, bukan, luar biasa tinggi.

column1: (Liushih sent over the wiretapped audio she just recorded, along with the panoramic thermal imaging taken by Dilu, all at once.)
column2: (Liushih mengirim audio sadapan yang baru dia rekam sekaligus citra termal panorama yang diambil Dilu, semuanya sekali kirim.)

column1: Look here.
column2: Lihat ini.

column1: A large number of bunker busters, artillery, heavy armored vehicles, tens of thousands of supplies... all trapped in a one-way street with no tactical depth.
column2: Bunker buster dalam jumlah besar, artileri, kendaraan lapis baja berat, puluhan ribu pasokan... semuanya terkurung di jalan satu arah tanpa kedalaman taktis.

column1: Combined with the conversation we just heard, it can be inferred that Mangi Security's entire logistics structure is completely chaotic, the command chain is too complex, and supplies cannot be transferred out in time, resulting in a massive backlog at the distribution center.
column2: Digabung dengan percakapan yang baru kita dengar, bisa disimpulkan seluruh struktur logistik Mangi Security benar-benar kacau, rantai komandonya terlalu rumit, dan pasokan tidak bisa dipindahkan tepat waktu, sehingga menumpuk besar-besaran di pusat distribusi.

column1: (A soft chuckle came from the other end of the communication channel.)
column2: (Kekehan lirih datang dari ujung lain saluran komunikasi.)

column1: It really is an eye-opener.
column2: Ini benar-benar membuka mata.

column1: If the Commander saw this intelligence, they would definitely highly appreciate your sharpness.
column2: Kalau Commander melihat intel ini, beliau pasti sangat menghargai ketajamanmu.

column1: This is simply a feast tailor-made for our surprise attack.
column2: Ini benar-benar hidangan yang dijahit khusus untuk serangan kejutan kita.

column1: I think the tactical arrangement is already very clear.
column2: Kurasa susunan taktisnya sudah sangat jelas.

column1: We just need to "cut off the head, remove the tail, and bloom in the middle" to throw Mangi Security's logistics into complete chaos.
column2: Kita hanya perlu "potong kepalanya, buang ekornya, dan ledakkan tengahnya" untuk membuat logistik Mangi Security kacau total.

column1: What we can take will all become Mokosh's supplies; what we can't take, let them become Mangi Security's most brilliant funeral fireworks!
column2: Yang bisa kita bawa akan jadi pasokan Mokosh; yang tidak bisa kita bawa, biar jadi kembang api pemakaman termegah Mangi Security!

column1: The third-generation Doll squad will deliver the heaviest blow to them.
column2: Regu Doll generasi ketiga yang akan memberi pukulan terberat kepada mereka.

column1: (The sandstorm continued, but at the other end of the canyon, the grim reaper's noose had quietly tightened.)
column2: (Badai pasir berlanjut, tapi di ujung lain kanyon itu, jerat malaikat kematian sudah mengencang diam-diam.)

column1: (Without any superfluous pre-battle declarations, the descent of destruction happened in an instant.)
column2: (Tanpa deklarasi pra-tempur yang berlebihan, kehancuran turun dalam sekejap.)

column1: (Countless firepowers descended from the sky, pouring down on the enemy positions. Following that was an ear-splitting series of sympathetic detonations.)
column2: (Daya tembak tak terhitung turun dari langit, mencurah ke posisi musuh. Menyusul setelahnya rentetan ledakan berantai yang memecahkan telinga.)

column1: (Boom boom boom—)
column2: (Duar duar duar—)

column1: (The Third-generation Doll squad's raid was cold and deadly. Precision-guided bombs cut precisely into the most vulnerable nodes of the Mangi Security convoy like a scalpel.)
column2: (Serangan kilat regu Doll generasi ketiga itu dingin dan mematikan. Bom berpemandu presisi mengiris tepat simpul-simpul paling rapuh konvoi Mangi Security seperti pisau bedah.)

column1: Enemy attack! Enemy attack! Deploy the anti-aircraft fire net immediately!
column2: Serangan musuh! Serangan musuh! Segera pasang jaring tembakan antiudara!

column1: Damn it! The heavy armored vehicles of the Second Battalion, stop backing up, you're crushing the logistics troop carriers!
column2: Sialan! Kendaraan lapis baja berat Batalion Dua, berhenti mundur, kalian menggencet pengangkut personel logistik!

column1: Holy crap! Do you even know how to drive?!
column2: Buset! Kau bisa nyetir tidak sih?!

column1: Breaking down at this critical moment, don't drag me down to die with you!
column2: Mogok di saat sekritis ini, jangan tarik aku mati bersamamu!

column1: My wheel hub got blown out! Do you think I want this?!
column2: Tromol rodaku hancur ditembak! Kau pikir aku mau begini?!

column1: Stop making sarcastic remarks, the tanker trucks in front are all on fire! Hurry down and help me change the wheel hub!
column2: Berhenti menyindir, truk tanker di depan terbakar semua! Cepat turun dan bantu aku ganti tromolnya!

column1: Back up my ass! The road behind is completely blown up!
column2: Mundur apanya! Jalan di belakang sudah hancur total!

column1: Where are our anti-aircraft guns?! Why aren't they firing!
column2: Mana meriam antiudara kita?! Kenapa tidak menembak!

column1: Anti-aircraft guns my ass! The ammo supply vehicle is stuck five kilometers away! The turret can't turn around at all!
column2: Meriam antiudara apanya! Kendaraan pasokan amunisinya nyangkut lima kilometer dari sini! Turetnya sama sekali tidak bisa berputar!

column1: Hurry up and abandon the cars and run! How much pension are they paying you to risk your lives like this?!
column2: Cepat tinggalkan mobilnya dan lari! Berapa pensiun yang mereka bayar sampai kalian mempertaruhkan nyawa seperti ini?!

column1: (The logistics convoy, connected head to tail, was in chaos. They didn't even survive the first round of strikes before being completely paralyzed.)
column2: (Konvoi logistik yang tersambung kepala-ke-ekor itu kacau balau. Mereka bahkan tidak selamat dari gelombang serangan pertama sebelum lumpuh total.)

column1: (Vehicles fully loaded with high explosives and fuel turned into a continuous sea of fire, and the violent shockwaves flipped heavy trucks over like toys.)
column2: (Kendaraan bermuatan penuh bahan peledak dan bahan bakar berubah menjadi lautan api yang menyambung, dan gelombang kejut yang ganas membalikkan truk berat seperti mainan.)

column1: (Inside the canyon, Mangi Security soldiers fled in panic amidst the firelight and thick smoke. Their proud armored escorts crushed each other in the narrow terrain, completely reduced to burning iron coffins.)
column2: (Di dalam kanyon, tentara Mangi Security kabur panik di antara cahaya api dan asap tebal. Pengawal lapis baja yang mereka banggakan saling menggencet di medan sempit itu, benar-benar berubah menjadi peti besi yang terbakar.)

column1: Now! Dilu!
column2: Sekarang! Dilu!

column1: (With Liushih's command, the mechanical horse herd ambushing from the high ground swooped down along the steep rock walls like a pack of wolves smelling blood.)
column2: (Atas perintah Liushih, kawanan kuda mekanis yang mengintai dari ketinggian menukik turun di sepanjang dinding batu terjal seperti kawanan wolf yang mencium darah.)

column1: (No hesitation, no pause.)
column2: (Tanpa keraguan, tanpa jeda.)

column1: (Under Dilu's coordination network, dozens of mechanical horses displayed astonishing synergy. They nimbly shuttled between the burning wreckage and the chaotic enemy lines, their mechanical arms ejecting to directly lock the unaffected supplies onto the load-bearing racks on their backs.)
column2: (Di bawah jaringan koordinasi Dilu, puluhan kuda mekanis memperlihatkan sinergi yang mencengangkan. Mereka bergerak cekatan di antara bangkai yang membara dan barisan musuh yang kacau, lengan mekanisnya melontar untuk langsung mengunci pasokan yang masih utuh ke rak muatan di punggung mereka.)

column1: (The soldiers of Mangi Security didn't even have time to raise their guns and aim before this ghost-like transport formation returned fully loaded.)
column2: (Tentara Mangi Security bahkan tidak sempat mengangkat senjata dan membidik sebelum formasi transpor bak hantu itu kembali dengan muatan penuh.)

column1: The supplies the Commander needs are secured!
column2: Pasokan yang dibutuhkan Commander sudah aman!

column1: Dilu, full power output, destination Mokosh!
column2: Dilu, tenaga penuh, tujuan Mokosh!

column1: (Liushih led the mechanical horse herd, fully loaded with spoils, and sped away right under the enemy's nose.)
column2: (Liushih memimpin kawanan kuda mekanis yang penuh muatan rampasan, dan melesat kabur tepat di depan hidung musuh.)

column1: (However, Mangi Security was not entirely without the ability to resist.)
column2: (Namun Mangi Security bukan sepenuhnya tanpa kemampuan melawan.)

column1: (Buzz buzz buzz—)
column2: (Ngiing ngiing ngiing—)

column1: (A teeth-grinding high-frequency rotor sound came from behind and above.)
column2: (Suara rotor frekuensi tinggi yang membuat gigi ngilu datang dari belakang atas.)

column1: (A squad of armed drones, having lost the guidance of the command vehicle but still following their target-seeking logic, doggedly bit onto the trail of Liushih's retreat.)
column2: (Satu regu drone bersenjata yang sudah kehilangan pengarahan kendaraan komando tapi masih mengikuti logika pencarian sasaran, menggigit keras jejak mundurnya Liushih.)

column1: Dammit...
column2: Sialan...

column1: (Liushih glanced back. The drones' red compound eyes flashed in the sandstorm, and the tracer bullets from their micro autocannons had already begun to weave a deadly net of fire in front of the swarm.)
column2: (Liushih melirik ke belakang. Mata majemuk merah drone itu berkelip di badai pasir, dan proyektil penjejak dari autocannon miniaturnya sudah mulai merajut jaring api mematikan di depan kawanan.)

column1: (Rat-tat-tat-tat-tat...)
column2: (Tratatatatata...)

column1: (Bullets hit the rocks around the mechanical horse herd, sparking blindingly.)
column2: (Proyektil menghantam bebatuan di sekitar kawanan kuda mekanis, memercikkan bunga api yang menyilaukan.)

column1: (Carrying such heavy supplies, being tailed by a drone swarm in an open area is an absolute dead end. Moreover, if this tail is brought to the vicinity of Mokosh, it will inevitably expose their tracks.)
column2: (Dengan pasokan seberat itu, dikejar kawanan drone di area terbuka sama dengan jalan buntu. Lebih parah, kalau pengejar ini terbawa sampai dekat Mokosh, jejak mereka pasti terbongkar.)

column1: ...I absolutely cannot bring danger to the Commander.
column2: ...Aku sama sekali tidak boleh membawa bahaya ke Commander.

column1: (Just then, Liushih noticed a continuous canyon ahead of her galloping path.)
column2: (Tepat saat itu, Liushih melihat kanyon bersambung di depan jalur lajunya.)

column1: (Her Neural cloud calculated for a moment and quickly came up with a countermeasure.)
column2: (Neural cloud-nya menghitung sesaat dan cepat menemukan penangkalnya.)

column1: Dilu, correct the route!
column2: Dilu, koreksi rutenya!

column1: (The mechanical horse herd neatly drew an arc while speeding at full throttle, plunging headlong into a fault canyon with extremely complex terrain.)
column2: (Kawanan kuda mekanis itu menarik busur dengan rapi sambil melaju kecepatan penuh, menerjun masuk ke kanyon patahan yang medannya sangat rumit.)

column1: (The rock walls here are steep and rich in high-density metal veins, and the distance between the two walls is extremely narrow, like a natural abyss.)
column2: (Dinding batu di sini terjal dan kaya urat logam berdensitas tinggi, dan jarak antara kedua dindingnya sangat sempit, seperti jurang alami.)

column1: (The drone swarm followed closely behind, pouring into the canyon like a black swarm of bees.)
column2: (Kawanan drone mengikuti rapat di belakang, menyerbu masuk ke kanyon seperti kawanan lebah hitam.)

column1: Chase, chase to your heart's content...
column2: Kejar, kejar sampai puas...

column1: (Liushih led the mechanical horse herd and ran wildly with all her might.)
column2: (Liushih memimpin kawanan kuda mekanis dan berlari sekencang-kencangnya.)

column1: (However, during the wild run, Liushih had already ordered the mechanical horse herd to prepare the electromagnetic bombs they carried with them.)
column2: (Namun di tengah pelarian itu, Liushih sudah memerintahkan kawanan kuda mekanis menyiapkan bom elektromagnetik yang mereka bawa.)

column1: Five, four, three, two...
column2: Lima, empat, tiga, dua...

column1: (One!)
column2: (Satu!)

column1: Dilu! Right now!
column2: Dilu! Sekarang!

column1: (Subsequently, the mechanical horse herd fired several cylindrical bombs into the mid-air of the canyon behind them.)
column2: (Setelah itu, kawanan kuda mekanis melontarkan beberapa bom berbentuk tabung ke udara kanyon di belakang mereka.)

column1: (Beep, beep, beep...)
column2: (Bip, bip, bip...)

column1: (There was no towering blaze, only several strong electromagnetic pulse waves, invisible to the naked eye, detonating explosively between the narrow rock walls.)
column2: (Tidak ada kobaran api menjulang, hanya beberapa gelombang pulsa elektromagnetik kuat yang tak terlihat mata, meledak di antara dinding batu yang sempit.)

column1: (High-frequency electromagnetic waves hit the metal-rich canyon walls, beginning to reflect, refract, and scatter wildly.)
column2: (Gelombang elektromagnetik frekuensi tinggi menghantam dinding kanyon yang kaya logam, lalu mulai memantul, membias, dan berserak liar.)

column1: (This was Liushih's goal—to artificially create an extreme "radio multipath fading" effect in the enclosed, complex terrain.)
column2: (Itulah tujuan Liushih—menciptakan secara buatan efek "radio multipath fading" yang ekstrem di medan tertutup dan rumit itu.)

column1: (Countless distorted, overlapping reflected signals instantly jammed the drone swarm's receiving frequency bands.)
column2: (Sinyal pantulan yang tak terhitung, cacat, dan bertumpuk seketika mengacaukan pita frekuensi penerima kawanan drone.)

column1: (The originally uniform swarm formation fell into extremely fatal chaos the moment it lost its coordination network and navigation positioning.)
column2: (Formasi kawanan yang semula seragam jatuh ke kekacauan yang sangat fatal begitu jaringan koordinasi dan penentuan posisi navigasinya hilang.)

column1: (Bzz—Warning—Signal Lost—)
column2: (Bzz—Peringatan—Sinyal Hilang—)

column1: (The drones were like headless flies that had lost their sense of direction, some colliding with each other, some crashing directly into the hard rock walls.)
column2: (Drone-drone itu seperti lalat tanpa kepala yang kehilangan arah, sebagian bertabrakan satu sama lain, sebagian langsung menghantam dinding batu yang keras.)

column1: Fire!
column2: Tembak!

column1: (Liushih suddenly turned around on Dilu's back. Dilu and the other mechanical horses activated combat mode at this time, aiming at the drone swarm in mid-air that had fallen into chaos and lost its evasive capabilities.)
column2: (Liushih tiba-tiba berbalik di punggung Dilu. Dilu dan kuda mekanis lainnya mengaktifkan mode tempur saat itu, membidik kawanan drone di udara yang sudah kacau dan hilang kemampuan mengelaknya.)

column1: (Accompanied by a series of short, precise, and crisp gunshots, those drones still blindly circling in mid-air were picked off one by one, turning into falling fireballs.)
column2: (Disertai rentetan letusan pendek, presisi, dan nyaring, drone-drone yang masih berputar buta di udara itu dirontokkan satu per satu, berubah menjadi bola api yang berjatuhan.)

column1: (A few seconds later, the canyon returned to dead silence, leaving only the pungent smell of burnt engines.)
column2: (Beberapa detik kemudian, kanyon itu kembali sunyi total, meninggalkan hanya bau menyengat mesin terbakar.)

column1: (Beep beep.)
column2: (Bip bip.)

column1: (The communication channel reconnects, bringing OTs-14's slightly rushed voice.)
column2: (Saluran komunikasi tersambung kembali, membawa suara OTs-14 yang sedikit tergesa.)

column1: Liushih? Report your status.
column2: Liushih? Laporkan statusmu.

column1: We just captured a large number of enemy heavy firepower weapons here, including bunker busters.
column2: Kami baru merebut banyak senjata berdaya tembak berat milik musuh di sini, termasuk bunker buster.

column1: But when calculating the enemy's firepower, the radar showed a drone formation breaking away from the main battlefield and chasing towards your coordinates.
column2: Tapi saat menghitung daya tembak musuh, radar menunjukkan satu formasi drone melepaskan diri dari medan tempur utama dan mengejar ke koordinatmu.

column1: I was just about to have Sextans intercept them, but due to a strong electromagnetic interference, Sextans lost your signal.
column2: Aku baru mau menyuruh Sextans mencegat mereka, tapi karena gangguan elektromagnetik yang kuat, Sextans kehilangan sinyalmu.

column1: Are you and the mechanical horse herd still safe?
column2: Kau dan kawanan kuda mekanis masih aman?

column1: Phew...
column2: Fyuh...

column1: Don't worry, Miss OTs-14.
column2: Tenang saja, Miss OTs-14.

column1: The supplies are fine, and I'm fine...
column2: Pasokannya aman, dan aku juga aman...

column1: (Liushih looked back. The drone swarm that had been in hot pursuit just now had now turned into a pile of scrap metal.)
column2: (Liushih menoleh ke belakang. Kawanan drone yang tadi mengejar ketat sekarang sudah jadi tumpukan besi rongsok.)

column1: (She patted Dilu's metal back, the corners of her mouth curling into a proud arc.)
column2: (Dia menepuk punggung logam Dilu, sudut mulutnya melengkung membentuk busur bangga.)

column1: Horse, safe and sound!
column2: Kudanya, aman sentosa!
